advisories.detail: the session does not memoise the first observed source SHA; expected_source_sha256 is validated per run against the constructor value, which is not re-suppliable today. Harden if a future binding layer allows per-run expectations.

a failed run() does not auto-close the session. Deterministic release is available via close() or the context manager, and the cumulative accounts correctly refuse a retry, so this is not a leak — but auto-close-on-error would be tidier for unattended flows.
cross-process/cross-run uniqueness cannot be enforced by an in-process owner; a warrant-grade single-pass guarantee needs an authority-held durable mechanism or an operational control.
